title: Basque Cheesecake

ingredients.item: full-fat cream cheese, at room temperature

steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C) with a rack in the middle. Scrunch two large sheets of parchment, flatten them out, and use them to line a 9-inch (23 cm) springform pan, overlapping, pressed into the corners and standing about 5 cm above the rim.
Beat the cream cheese and sugar on medium until completely smooth and the sugar has dissolved, about 3 minutes, scraping the bowl a couple of times.
On low speed, add the eggs one at a time, mixing until each disappears. Mix in the salt and vanilla.
Pour in the cream in a slow stream, then sift the flour over the top and mix just until smooth. For an extra-silky texture, pour the batter through a sieve.
Pour into the pan and bake 55–65 minutes, until the top is a deep, almost-burnt brown and the cake has puffed, while the centre still jiggles a lot.
Let it cool in the pan to room temperature; it will sink, which is normal. Serve at room temperature for a soft, creamy middle, or chill for at least 4 hours for firmer slices.
